descriptionMarkdown:
Archeotech represents technology whose manufacture is poorly understood, lost or institutionally restricted. Its 
Availability describes access, not the ability to mass-produce it.
Item Availability Effect
Volkite Serpenta Exceptional 1d10 radiant/fire; 50/150 ft; Light, Reload 8. Once per turn when you hit a 
Bloodied target, deal +1d6 fire damage.
Volkite Charger Near-Unique 2d8 radiant/fire; 80/240 ft; Burst, Reload 12. Once per turn, if the target has 
already taken damage this round, deal +1d8 fire damage.
Suspensor Harness Exceptional
Choose one Heavy weapon you carry. You ignore its movement-based 
Heavy penalty. If it is Emplaced, you may fire it as though it were merely 
Heavy while the harness is functioning. Requires Strength 13+ or an 
appropriate interface.
Archeotech Logic Engine Exceptional
Advantage on Technology checks to identify or operate ancient machinery. 
Once per short rest, after rolling an Intelligence or Technology check, add 
1d8 before the result is declared.
Phase-Shunt Field Near-Unique
Once per long rest when damage would reduce you to 0 HP but not kill you 
outright, remain at 1 HP and teleport up to 15 ft to a visible unoccupied 
space. The field becomes Damaged after use until properly repaired.
Medicae Crucible Exceptional
Once per long rest as an action, a creature you touch regains 4d8 + 
proficiency bonus HP and ends Poisoned or one disease. It may suppress 
one lasting-injury penalty until its next long rest, but does not cure the 
injury.
